title: Revolver

title: Rubber Soul
scene: British beat / Merseybeat turning to folk rock (Parlophone, EMI Studios)

title: Sgt. Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band
scene: British psychedelia / Summer of Love (Parlophone, EMI Abbey Road)

title: Abbey Road
